objects.identity: Brown dog with floppy hanging ear, curled tail, four paws, muzzle, eye and dark nose.
Green butterfly with blue wing patches, long central body and downward curved antennae.
Brown three-segment ant with six jointed legs and two bent antennae.
Red ladybird with cream wing spots, darker red head and rim, six legs and two antennae.
Light tan cat with pointed ears, face, four paws and upward curled long tail.
Gray curved dolphin with right-pointing beak, eye, dorsal fin, pectoral flipper and forked tail.

ambiguities.note: The low-resolution cartoon contours are hand-reconstructed as explicit native Bézier artwork, not pixel-traced. Identity-defining anatomy, six colors, pose, handedness, and all transformations are preserved; subpixel texture and source JPEG blur are not semantic. Canonical source is the already-reflected second tile (identical to option C). Artwork must receive independent source-fidelity review.

Blue image1/image2 placeholders and horizontal blue divider are export wrappers, not puzzle geometry, and are omitted. Five options remain in one row. Fold geometry and relative tile radii (90 vs70) are preserved; the arrow/text has extra whitespace for 16pt repository typography.
